title: NodeUsage
description: Subscription quota of the node's runtimes (Claude Code, Codex), unreliable; sent after hello and then periodically. Never carries credentials; the account email (owner-only on the console) is the only identity it carries. The console keeps only the latest report per node and drops unknown fields.

auth.description: How the runtime is logged in: subscription (Claude), chatgpt (Codex), api_key, or none.

status.description: ok: windows are valid; error: fetching failed (see error); unsupported: no quota for this login (API key, not logged in, too old CLI).

plan.description: Plan name when known: Claude's subscription type (pro, max, team, enterprise), Codex's plan type (plus, pro, prolite, promax, team, ...).

plan_tier.description: Claude only: the CLI's plan tier from `claude auth status` (pro, max_5x, max_20x, max_other, other); absent when unknown.

email.description: Email of the logged-in subscription account (Claude: `claude auth status`; Codex: app-server account/read). Absent for API key logins or when unknown. The console shows it to the node's owner only.

windows.description: At most 8 are kept by the console.

fetched_at.description: When the daemon fetched this data.

key.description: five_hour, weekly, weekly_opus, weekly_sonnet, weekly_model (per-model weekly window, see label) (Claude); primary, secondary (Codex).

label.description: Display name given by the provider, e.g. the model of a weekly_model window; the console keeps at most 40 characters.

used_percent.description: 0..100; the console clamps values out of range.
